body:
Source: GitHub issue #805 (bug, P2-medium, area:plugins). Re-verified on main @ b2b5c6ea: plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/adlc-lifecycle.mjs:365 reads `const isMain = process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === `file://${process.argv[1]}`;` and the file imports nothing from node:url. Node percent-encodes import.meta.url (a space becomes %20); the hand-built string does not, so from any install path containing a space or another encoded character (and on Windows, where a file URL is not `file://` plus the path) the comparison is always false, main() never runs, and the hook exits 0 with empty stdout. Repro: copy plugins/adlc-codex/hooks to a directory whose name contains a space, then `echo '{}' | node "<copy>/hooks/adlc-lifecycle.mjs" bogus-mode-xyz` prints nothing and exits 0; from a path without a space it prints `{"systemMessage":"ADLC advisory hook could not complete: unknown lifecycle mode: bogus-mode-xyz"}` and exits 0. hooks/hooks.json wires this one file to eight hook entries - SessionStart, PostToolUse (flail), PreCompact, PostCompact, SubagentStart, SubagentStop and both Stop hooks (verify, review) - so all of them go silent.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `plugins/adlc-codex` (@adlc/codex). `hooks/adlc-lifecycle.mjs` is both an executable hook (`node adlc-lifecycle.mjs <context|flail|verify|review>`, JSON payload on stdin, JSON on stdout, always exit 0) and an importable module: `hooks/test/review-notice.test.mjs` imports its pure exports, which is why the is-main guard exists. The two sibling guards in this plugin are already correct: `hooks/adlc-build-gate.mjs:377` (one line) and `hooks/adlc-handoff-gate.mjs:1348-1349` (the same expression wrapped over two lines). Tests: `node --test plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/*.test.mjs` from the worktree root; the directory is globbed by scripts/run-tests.mjs, so a new *.test.mjs file needs no registration, and package.json "files" ships `hooks/*.mjs` only, so the test is not published. `hooks/test/build-gate-space-path.test.mjs` shows the copy-to-a-space-path technique (do not copy its `realpathSync(mkdtempSync(...))` shape - see TEST FILE). The hook imports sibling modules (`./generated-ticket-reader.mjs`, `./generated-active-ticket.mjs`, `./generated-glob-match.mjs`), so a copy must include the whole hooks directory. Live consumer in CI: the required test job runs `scripts/codex-install-smoke.mjs`, which spawns the installed hook in flail mode and requires `ADLC advisory hook could not complete` on stdout; this change must not alter that.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In `hooks/adlc-lifecycle.mjs` add `import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';` next to the other node: imports and replace the guard with exactly `const isMain = Boolean(process.argv[1]) && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href;` - the same expression the two sibling hooks use. No helper, no new module, no new export.
2. `Boolean(process.argv[1]) &&` is required: `pathToFileURL(undefined)` throws, and importing the module with no argv[1] must keep working silently.
3. Replace the guard's comment with at most three lines stating why pathToFileURL is used (import.meta.url is percent-encoded, a hand-built URL string is not). Do not quote the old expression verbatim in the comment - AC5 greps for its absence.
4. Regression guard: importing the module never runs main(), never reads stdin and writes nothing to stdout; every existing mode behaves exactly as today from a path without a space; the process still always exits 0.
5. Output shape used by the tests: in `context` mode with event SessionStart the hook prints `{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"ADLC current ticket: <id> ..."}}` - the context is NESTED under hookSpecificOutput. With no mode argument the mode defaults to `context`, and with no hook_event_name in the payload the event defaults to SessionStart.
6. No documentation changes: no README or docs page describes install-path handling.

TEST FILE. Create `plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/lifecycle-entry-point.test.mjs`. Rules that other guards enforce: (a) spawn child processes only through `runHook`/`spawnHook` from `./helpers/run-hook.mjs` - raw execFileSync/spawnSync of process.execPath is banned in this directory by scripts/test/hook-spawn-timeout-drift.test.mjs; (b) always pass `input` so stdin is closed - a child that reaches main() with an open stdin blocks until the helper's deadline; (c) scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs matches the text `mkdtempSync(` anywhere in the file - comments and strings included - and requires each match to be bound directly to a name that a later `rmSync(<name>` removes, counted per name. So: write the call exactly once, inside one sandbox helper that every test uses, as `const raw = mkdtempSync(...); const base = realpathSync(raw);` with `rmSync(raw, { recursive: true, force: true })` in its finally block, and never spell that call in a comment. Wrapping the call in realpathSync on the same line counts as unbound, and the guard's allowlist may not grow; (d) realpath the temp base BEFORE appending the space-containing segment; (e) copy the hooks directory with cpSync and a filter that skips the `test` subdirectory (`filter: (src) => basename(src) !== 'test'`); (f) spawn with `env: { ...process.env, ADLC_TICKET_STORE: '', ADLC_TICKETS: '', ADLC_TICKET: '' }` so an exported ticket-store override in the builder's shell cannot redirect the fixture lookup. Fixture repo with an active ticket: `.adlc/tickets.json` = `{"tickets":[{"id":"T1","title":"entry point","category":"contract","scope":["src/**"],"rails":[],"edges":[]}]}` and `.adlc/current-ticket.json` = `{"id":"T1"}`.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 From a copy whose path contains a space, mode `bogus-mode-xyz` with input `{}` exits 0 and prints JSON whose systemMessage matches /unknown lifecycle mode: bogus-mode-xyz/. Fails before the fix (empty stdout). verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/lifecycle-entry-point.test.mjs`
- AC2 From the same kind of copy, with NO mode argument and input `{"cwd":"<fixture repo>"}`, stdout is JSON with hookSpecificOutput.hookEventName === 'SessionStart' and hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext matching /ADLC current ticket: T1/. Fails before the fix. This is the only test that fails when the guard reads argv[2] where it should read argv[1]; every existing test passes a mode. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/lifecycle-entry-point.test.mjs`
- AC3 Importing does not run main(): write an importer file containing `await import(<file URL of plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/adlc-lifecycle.mjs>)` into the test's temp directory, run it with cwd = the fixture repo and input ''; assert status 0 AND stdout === ''. The stdout assertion is mandatory - a guard that wrongly runs main() also exits 0 and differs only by printing the ticket context. Passes before and after the fix. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/lifecycle-entry-point.test.mjs`
- AC4 Importing with no argv[1] does not throw: run `--input-type=module -e "await import(<hook file URL>)"` with input ''; assert status 0 and empty stderr. Passes before and after the fix. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/lifecycle-entry-point.test.mjs`
- AC5 The guard uses the sibling expression and the hand-built form is gone. verify: `grep -cF 'import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href' plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/adlc-lifecycle.mjs plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/adlc-build-gate.mjs` prints `:1` for each file, and `! grep -qF 'file://${process.argv[1]}' plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/adlc-lifecycle.mjs` exits 0
- AC6 Existing codex hook suite green with no existing test edited. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/*.test.mjs`
- AC7 Repo-wide guards that scan this directory stay green. verify: `node --test scripts/test/hook-spawn-timeout-drift.test.mjs scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs`
- AC8 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally). Expect three mutants, all on the guard line. The one that swaps && for || makes every test file that imports the module wait on stdin, so that single run ends at the gate's 180-second per-run limit and is scored as killed - slow, not a failure.

OUT OF SCOPE: install roots reached through a symbolic link (argv[1] is not canonicalised while import.meta.url is; the hook stays silent there before and after this change) - the new tests must assert nothing about symlinks; the same hand-built guard in scripts/guard-findings-ledger-append-only.mjs, scripts/block-secret-exposure.mjs, scripts/ceremony-drift.mjs, scripts/scan-findings-ledger.mjs and apps/docs/scripts/check-links.mjs; any change to adlc-build-gate.mjs, adlc-handoff-gate.mjs, adlc-rails-guard.mjs or hooks.json; sharing code between the Codex and Copilot plugins; a Windows test.
title: adlc-codex: lifecycle hook must run main() when the plugin's install path contains a space
